title: ToolTest 4 - Loop, Ring and Chain Selection

courses.title: ToolTest 4 - Loop, Ring and Chain Selection
courses.objective: Practice topology-aware loop, ring and chain expansion and verify only the intended connected set is selected.

steps.title: Create a topology-rich reference model
steps.instructions: Create a body with multiple connected edge paths and loops.
steps.expectedResult: Several candidate edge paths are available.

checkpoint.expected: Several candidate edge paths are available.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, restore the reference selection, and repeat the step with the listed inputs.

steps.title: Chain selection
steps.instructions: Select a seed edge and expand to its connected chain.
steps.expectedResult: A connected edge chain is selected.

checkpoint.expected: A connected edge chain is selected.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, restore the reference selection, and repeat the step with the listed inputs.

steps.title: Loop selection
steps.instructions: Select an edge and expand to the corresponding loop.
steps.expectedResult: A closed or topology-consistent loop is selected.

checkpoint.expected: A closed or topology-consistent loop is selected.

validationChecks: Loop selection follows the intended perimeter
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, restore the reference selection, and repeat the step with the listed inputs.

steps.title: Ring selection
steps.instructions: Select a seed edge and expand across the corresponding ring.
steps.expectedResult: The corresponding edge ring becomes selected.

checkpoint.expected: The corresponding edge ring becomes selected.

validationChecks: Selection does not spill into unrelated edges
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, restore the reference selection, and repeat the step with the listed inputs.
